_comment: Which Red Hat advisories go into which README. cves: shown in full, or summarized when a CVE has more than 20 advisories and the README has no focus; summary: shown as counts only; point: a CVE whose advisories are listed in another README; focus: a package pattern listed first, and the only ones listed for a CVE with many advisories; matrix: the kernel layout; note: one sentence about what the advisories are for; label: how other READMEs name this one.
_excluded_why: The main README points at the index document. GitLab only cites the Ruby flaws, and Omnibus GitLab bundles its own Ruby.
_known_outside_window_why: January advisories the vsftpd README names, before the Red Hat list starts.

brotli/README.md.note: Firefox, Thunderbird and other packages that bundle the Brotli decoder carry the same CVE; they are counted, not listed.
brotli/README.md.label: Brotli

haproxy/README.md.note: The only advisory is for a 3.0 build, although HAProxy gives 3.1 as the first affected line: `check` says so for a 3.0 build that is a Red Hat one.

jenkins/README.md.note: These are the OpenShift Jenkins images, not the RHEL packages.

openssl/README.md.note: Other packages that bundle OpenSSL carry the same CVE; they are counted, not listed.

pki/README.md.note: This is the Go standard library flaw named above, so the advisories are for Go programs, not for the certificate store.

storybook/README.md.note: Red Hat's advisories for this CVE are for Grafana, not for a package called Storybook.
